# Coms Advance Engineering

> Software engineering company specializing in full-stack development, mobile applications, and AI integration. Creators of ORBS, Emailify, and BudgetGuard.

## About

Coms Advance Engineering is a software development company that builds web applications, mobile apps, and enterprise solutions. We prioritize client collaboration and are flexible with time zone communications.

- About us: https://comengineering.services/about
- Contact: https://comengineering.services/contact

## Products

- ORBS — All-in-one business management platform (team management, inventory, accounting, purchases, sales): https://comengineering.services/products/orbs (app: https://orbs.comengineering.services)
- Emailify — Professional email signature management for teams with 50+ templates, click tracking, and cross-platform support: https://comengineering.services/products/emailify (app: https://emailify.comengineering.services)
- BudgetGuard — Privacy-first, all-local budget management app (coming soon): https://comengineering.services/products/budgetguard

## Services

- Full-Stack Web Development (React, Next.js, NestJS, Django, Express)
- Mobile Application Development (Flutter for iOS and Android)
- Blockchain Development (Ethereum, Solidity)
- AI/ML Integration (OpenAI, TensorFlow, Hugging Face)
- Cloud & DevOps (AWS, Azure, Docker)
- Database Design (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL)

## Tech Stack

React, Next.js, NestJS, Flutter, TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Docker, AWS, Azure, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase, TailwindCSS, Redux, TensorFlow, OpenAI, Pinecone
